mapper.sql: id, tenant_id, document_id, document_version_id, document_version, content_fingerprint, status, stage, attempt_count, max_attempts, next_attempt_at, lease_token, leased_until, last_error_code, last_error_message, created_at, updated_at, started_at, finished_at
mapper.select: WITH candidates AS ( SELECT id FROM document_ingestion_job WHERE (status IN ('QUEUED', 'RETRYING') AND next_attempt_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) OR (status = 'PROCESSING' AND leased_until <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ORDER BY next_attempt_at, id FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED LIMIT #{limit} ), claimed AS ( UPDATE document_ingestion_job j SET status = 'PROCESSING', stage = 'CLAIMED', lease_token = md5(random()::text || clock_timestamp()::text || j.id::text), leased_until = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP + (#{leaseMillis} * INTERVAL '1 millisecond'), attempt_count = j.attempt_count + CASE WHEN j.status = 'PROCESSING' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, started_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, last_error_code = CASE WHEN j.status = 'PROCESSING' THEN 'LEASE_EXPIRED' ELSE j.last_error_code END, last_error_message = CASE WHEN j.status = 'PROCESSING' THEN 'Worker lease expired; processing resumed.' ELSE j.last_error_message END FROM candidates c WHERE j.id = c.id RETURNING j.* ) SELECT * FROM claimed ORDER BY id
SELECT id FROM tenant WHERE id = #{tenantId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(version), 0) + 1 FROM document_ingestion_version WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND document_id = #{documentId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO document_ingestion_version (tenant_id, document_id, version, content_fingerprint, storage_path, title, file_name, mime_type, size_bytes, active, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{version.tenantId}, #{version.documentId}, #{version.version}, #{version.contentFingerprint}, #{version.storagePath}, #{version.title}, #{version.fileName}, #{version.mimeType}, #{version.sizeBytes}, FALSE, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, document_id, version) DO NOTHING

INSERT INTO document_ingestion_job (tenant_id, document_id, document_version_id, document_version, content_fingerprint, status, stage, attempt_count, max_attempts, next_attempt_at, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{job.tenantId}, #{job.documentId}, #{job.documentVersionId}, #{job.documentVersion}, #{job.contentFingerprint}, 'QUEUED', 'UPLOADED', 0, #{job.maxAttempts}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, document_id, document_version, content_fingerprint) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT doc_name FROM document WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{documentId}
mapper.update: UPDATE document_ingestion_job SET stage='INGESTING', updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id} AND status='PROCESSING' AND lease_token=#{token} AND leased_until > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM document_chunk WHERE document_id=#{documentId} AND document_version_id=#{versionId}
mapper.update: UPDATE document_ingestion_version SET active=FALSE, updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND document_id=#{documentId} AND id<>#{versionId} AND active=TRUE
UPDATE document_ingestion_version SET active=TRUE, updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{versionId} AND tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND document_id=#{documentId}

UPDATE document d SET title=v.title, content_fingerprint=v.content_fingerprint, status='INGESTED', version=v.version, chunk_count=(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM document_chunk c WHERE c.document_id=d.id AND c.document_version_id=v.id), updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM document_ingestion_version v WHERE v.id=#{versionId} AND v.document_id=d.id AND v.tenant_id=d.tenant_id AND d.id=#{documentId} AND d.tenant_id=#{tenantId}

UPDATE document_ingestion_job SET status=CASE WHEN #{attempt} >= #{maxAttempts} THEN 'FAILED' ELSE 'RETRYING' END, stage=CASE WHEN #{attempt} >= #{maxAttempts} THEN 'FAILED' ELSE 'CLAIMED' END, next_attempt_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP + (#{delayMillis} * INTERVAL '1 millisecond'), lease_token=NULL, leased_until=NULL, finished_at=CASE WHEN #{attempt} >= #{maxAttempts} THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ELSE NULL END, last_error_code=#{code}, last_error_message=#{message}, updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id} AND status='PROCESSING' AND lease_token=#{token}

UPDATE document_ingestion_job SET status='RETRYING', stage='CLAIMED', lease_token=NULL, leased_until=NULL, next_attempt_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE status='PROCESSING' AND leased_until <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
